prerequisites: Knowledge equivalent to standard secondary school curricula
Active use of language skills, vocabulary and grammar covered in the GEN1 course

learning_outcomes.text: Develop active speaking skills and the ability to communicate confidently in the contexts of university study, individual specialisation and future professional employment.
Systematically review and deepen key grammatical structures in more complex, authentic contexts.
Formulate ideas independently and communicate with confidence, preparing for more demanding academic and professional communication situations.

syllabus_topics: U5: Technology. Comparing advantages and disadvantages. Comparatives and superlatives.
U5: Describing a new concept. Question tags.
U6: Imagining alternatives. Hypothetical conditional: present/future.
U7: Success. Verb phrases. Present perfect simple versus continuous.
U7: Skills, abilities. Present and past ability.
U7: Qualifications. Explaining and clarifying opinions.
U8: Student accommodation, social situations. Articles and quantifiers.
U8: Online activities, flatshare. Relative clauses.
U8: Welcoming a visitor. Studying abroad.
Computer assisted language learning topics and areas dealt with in the main part of the course.
Use of authentic videos to practice and develop language skills.

assessment_methods.method: Active participation in seminars and completion of optional activities

assessment_rules: Students must achieve a minimum of 24 points out of a maximum of 40 points on the credit test. The credit also reflects active participation in seminars and completion of optional activities, which may be worth up to 4 points. In case of failure, students have one resit opportunity. Attendance at seminars is compulsory; students are allowed to miss two language seminars.
institution: WYSOKÉ UCENI TECHNICKÉ V BRNE - Brno University of Technology
